purpose: CPU-only bounded replay of endpoint and interval-radiance candidates using archived exact-state HDR evidence
direct_state_sampling: use only exact rows present in the immutable state_control_trace; the saved direct HDR evidence is at 1 kHz from 0.5815 through 0.5905 s

causal_input.representation: five causal 5 ms bins, two polarities, 64x64, log1p counts

response.radiance_source: saved Genesis native float32 scene-linear HDR frames

render_request_fulfillment.exact_saved_timestamp: fill candidate-requested pixels from the exact saved direct HDR frame
render_request_fulfillment.timestamp_without_saved_direct_render: fill from the nearer endpoint only to keep event emulation defined; count all such pixels as unresolved and do not treat these outputs as validated images

boundaries.physics: immutable logged states; no physics advance or synthetic state
boundaries.renderer: no new Genesis renderer or EGL/CUDA allocation
boundaries.geometry_gt: used inside Ours-style reconstruction and for post-inference scoring only
